hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.md|*.yaml|*.yml|*.json|*.toml) oxfmt --write "$f" ;; esac; if [ -d .jj ]; then jj delta "$f"; elif [ -d .git ]; then git diff --color=always "$f"; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
